before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read sales data and calculate total revenue by region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
totals = df.groupby('region', as_index=True)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
ax.bar(totals.index, totals.values, color=['#4C78A8', '#F58518'])
ax.set_title('Total Revenue by Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Region')
ax.set_ylabel('Total revenue')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(totals.values) * 1.15)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
